core_commitments.rule: State axioms once and precisely; define symbols and scope.
Derive immediate consequences by mathematics and logic only.
Introduce constraints or structure as explicit modelling choices.
Do not import external laws or tacit empirical rules mid-derivation.
Do not retrofit axioms or add hidden premises to force a target result.
Keep scope local and mark excluded cases out of scope.
Bind each derived claim to its axioms and choices and provide falsification hooks.

relational_foundations.rule: Within the model universe, only declared distinctions, induced relations, and their mathematics exist.
Undeclared absolute properties do not enter derivations.
Information measures are bookkeeping constraints, not physical laws.
Do not elevate representational limitations to universal laws.
